t: Shetztzarik lekavven bekol habberakot vesheyyakol lehitpallel bekol lashon
s: Shetztzarik lekavven bekol habberakot vesheyyakol lehitpallel bekol lashon ubo h' seipim: hammitpallel tzarik sheyyekavven bekol habberakot. Veim eno yakol lekavven bekullan — lepachot yekavven be"abot". Uleolam yamod adam et atzmo, im yakol lekavven libbo be"abot" — yitpallel, veim lav — al yitpallel ad shettityashsheb dato veyukal lekavven be"abot" lepachot. Veim lo kivven be"abot" ap al pi shekkivven bekol hashshear — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel. Veakshav en chozerin bishbil chesron kavvana, sheap bachazara qarob hu shello yekavven, im ken lamma yachazor. Abal qeriat shema sheiqqar mitzvat kavvanatah enah ella pasuq rishon — chozerin, shebbeqal yukal lekavven. Veken pasuq "poteach et yadeka" shebbipsuqe dezimra, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a (vs"a) [vs"g]. Veyargil adam et atzmo sheyyekavven lepachot bachatimat kol beraka, sheyyesh bahen qy"g tebot kemo sheyyesh bitpillat channa, veqay"g peamim leb beHashem chumshe tora, lomar shetztzarik kavvanat halleb:

Lo yitpallel belibbo lebad, ella mechattek haddebarim bispatayv umashmia leoznayv belachash. Velo yashmia qolo (leacher haomed etzlo chutz led' ammotayv), shenneemar: "raq sepateha naot veqolah lo yishshamea". Vekol hammashmia qolo bitpillato — hare zeh miqqetanne amana, keillu en haqqadosh baruk hu shomea tepillat lachash (vachakamim tiqqenu tepilla belachash legamre shello lehashmia ella leoznayv bilbad, kede shello lebayyesh obere abera shehem mitvaddim al avonotehem battepilla):

Veim eno yakol lekavven belachash, o sheeno yakol lekavven kol kak kemo beqol ram — muttar lehagbiah qolo kede lekavven yapeh. Vehu shemmitpallel beno leben atzmo, abal betzibbur asur lehagbiah qolo, mippene shemmatrid hatztzibbur. Ella im eno yakol lekavven belachash — yelek veyitpallel bebeto beqol. Vaapillu im yakol lekavven belachash kemo beqol, im mashmia qolo keshemmitpallel bebeto kede sheyyilmedu mimmennu bene beto nussach hattepilla — muttar. Velaken nohagin shebberosh hashshana veyom kippur magbihin qolam, kede sheyyelammedu zeh et zeh, mippene sheen regilin bitpillot ellu. Veod kede leorer hakkavvana beyoter, mippene shehem yeme teshuba, veen chosheshim sheyyatridu veyatu zeh et zeh kevan shessiddurim umachazorim beyadam. Veap al pi ken yoter tob lehitpallel belachash im yakol lekavven. Veal kol panim yizzaharu shello lehagbiah qolam yoter midday, shekkol hammagbiah qolo harbeh — hare zeh minnebie hashsheqer, shenneemar bahem: "vayyiqreu beqol gadol". Umikkol maqom, sheliach tzibbur hammagbiah qolo kede leorer hakkavvana ulehashmia yapeh labberiyyot — yapeh hu oseh, sheiqqar tepillat hashsheliach tzibbur nitqena beqol ram, abal otam sheosim ken leharot qolam — osim shello kahogen:
Hammitpallel belachash velo hishmia leoznayv — yatza. Abal im hitpallel belibbo velo hotzi bispatayv — lo yatza, shehirhur eno kedibbur:

Yakol lehitpallel bekol lashon sheyyirtzeh keshemmitpallel betzibbur. Abal beyachid lo yitpallel ella bilshon haqqodesh, lepi sheen malake hashsharet makkirin bishar leshonot, vehayyachid tzarik lemalak melitz leqabbel tepillato. Abal tzibbur en tzarik lemelitz, shenneemar: "hen el kabbir lo yimas". Vehannashim shennahagu lehitpallel belaa"z tepillat y"ch shehen chayyabot bahen kaanashim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (q"y) [q"v] — yesh shellimmedu alehen zekut lomar, shello maneu layyachid lehitpallel bishar leshonot ella kesheshshoel tzerakayv, kegon shemmitpallel al hacholeh o al shum tzaar sheyyesh lo bebeto, abal tepilla haqqabua letzibbur — apillu yachid yakol leomrah bekol lashon. Veyesh shellimmedu alehen zekut acher lomar, shello maneu lehayyachid millehitpallel bishar leshonot ella millashon arammi bilbad, shehu megunneh beene malake hashsharet veenam nizqaqin lo, abal makkirin veyodeim bekol halleshonot, apillu machshebot libbo shel adam. Vekol zeh lelammed zekut al hannashim shechayyabot bitpilla, lamma mitpalelot belaa"z veenan lomedot et hattepilla bilshon haqqodesh im perush hammillot, abal am haaretz sheeno mebin bilshon haqqodesh ap al pi sheyyukal lehitpallel bilshon haqqodesh — mutab sheyyitpallel belashon shemmebin apillu beyachid kede sheyyekavven libbo mimmah sheyyitpallel bilshon haqqodesh belo kavvanat halleb, shettepilla belo kavvana — enah kelum:
